probes.name: nested
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim s As String
s = "A"
GoSub First
Probe = s & "Z"
Exit Function
First:
s = s & "B"
GoSub Second
s = s & "D"
Return
Second:
s = s & "C"
Return
End Function

probes.name: loop
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim i As Long, s As String
For i = 1 To 3
    GoSub Append
    s = s & "!"
Next
Probe = s
Exit Function
Append:
s = s & CStr(i)
Return
End Function

probes.name: goto_in_subroutine
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
GoSub First
Probe = Probe & "Z"
Exit Function
First:
Probe = "A"
GoTo Second
Second:
Probe = Probe & "B"
Return
End Function

probes.name: early_exit
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
GoSub First
Probe = "wrong"
Exit Function
First:
Probe = "exit"
Exit Function
End Function

probes.name: return_without_gosub
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
On Error Resume Next
Return
Probe = CStr(Err.Number)
End Function

probes.name: resume_next
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
On Error Resume Next
GoSub First
Probe = Probe & "Z"
Exit Function
First:
Err.Raise 11
Probe = CStr(Err.Number)
Return
End Function

probes.name: handler_resume
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Handler
GoSub First
Probe = Probe & "Z"
Exit Function
First:
Err.Raise 11
Probe = Probe & "B"
Return
Handler:
Probe = CStr(Err.Number)
Resume Next
End Function

probes.name: handler_return
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Handler
GoSub First
Probe = Probe & "Z:" & CStr(Err.Number)
Exit Function
First:
Err.Raise 11
Probe = "wrong"
Return
Handler:
Probe = CStr(Err.Number)
Return
End Function

probes.name: numeric_label
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
GoSub 100
Probe = Probe & "Z"
Exit Function
100 Probe = "N"
Return
End Function

probes.name: fall_off_procedure
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
GoSub Last
Probe = "wrong"
Exit Function
Last:
Probe = "end"
End Function

probes.name: conditional_return
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim n As Long
GoSub First
GoSub First
Probe = CStr(n)
Exit Function
First:
n = n + 1
If n = 1 Then
    Return
End If
n = n + 10
Return
End Function

probes.name: gosub_from_handler
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Handler
Err.Raise 11
Probe = Probe & "Z"
Exit Function
Worker:
Probe = Probe & "W"
Return
Handler:
Probe = "H"
GoSub Worker
Resume Next
End Function

probes.name: returned_stack_empty
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
On Error Resume Next
GoSub Worker
Return
Probe = CStr(Err.Number)
Exit Function
Worker:
Return
End Function

probes.name: goto_after_error
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Handler
GoSub Worker
Probe = Probe & "Z"
Exit Function
Worker:
Err.Raise 11
Return
Handler:
Probe = "H"
GoTo Finish
Finish:
Probe = Probe & "F"
Return
End Function
